1.The unaudited financial  results of the Company have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) as prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act 2013 read with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standard) Rules, 2015 (as amended).   2.The figures of the Fourth Quarter  for Standalone Operations are the balancing figures between audited figures in respect of full financial year upto 31st March, 2024 and un-audited year to date figures upto the third quarter ended 31st December, 2023 which were subjected to limited review.   3.The total exceptional item for the quarter and Year ended 31st March, 2024 includes Rs.235.77 lakhs is towards provision for Impairment of assets in Sugar Unit at Bhimadole and Rs. 259.01 lakhs is towards provision for impairment of assets in Power Generation unit at Tanuku.   4.Decrease in Profit and Turnover is mainly on account of decrease in the Selling Prices of Chlor-Alkali (Caustic Soda and its Bye-Products) and Chemicals.    5.Other Income for the quarter ended June 30th, 2024 includes Rs. 1178.59 lakhs towards sale of Scrap and Rs. 561.73 lakhs towards Dividend from the Associate.   6.The above unaudited financial results of the Company have been reviewed  by  the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective Meetings held on 12.08.2024 and statutory auditors have carried out the  limited review.   7.Previous period figures have been re-grouped wherever necessary to conform the current period presentation.
